thread:
Rahul M: Hey team — noticed a burst of owner flips on inbound leads this morning around 02:10 UTC. quick look: HubSpot enrichment lag spikes + our RR window is too aggressive. only takes one retry to cause a reassign loop.
Leah T: Yep. saw 40% of assigns had enrichment_state==pending. Current RR timeout 18s is basically matching the median enrichment latency during the spike.
Dario F: Proposed low-risk mitigation: add a 2-step assign flow. 1) fast-assign when enrichment_ready==true and required_fields_present. 2) otherwise, mark lead.assign_hold_until = now + 3m and enqueue to deferred_assign.
Hannah S: 3m seems OK. we should also bump sticky_owner_ttl to 2h for leads that get reassigned so they don't bounce back and forth.
Rahul M: Agree. Also add an "assignment_idempotency_key" on the write to CRM: lead.create_ts + pipeline_id + last_assignment_hash. CRM writes should noop if key matches last.
Leah T: Observability: add metrics assign.defer_rate, assign.fastpath_pct, assign.flap_count. alert if flap_count > 5/region/hr.
Dario F: HubSpot workflow quick pseudo:
```
IF enrichment_ready == true AND confidence_score > 0.75 -> set assign_mode = 'fast'
ELSE -> set assign_mode = 'defer' and suppress_until = now + 3m
```
Hannah S: Ops playbook quick: 1) If deferred queue grows > 200 leads -> pause new defers and open incident. 2) Run rehydrate on delayed enrichments and requeue. 3) Notify #sales-inbound with sample leads.
Rahul M: Rollout: feature flag "assign_hybrid_flow". Canary to APAC night window first (00:00-06:00 local) for 24h. Success if flap_count drops >=40% and SLA hit-rate (first-touch within 15m) drops <3%.
Leah T: I'll stub dashboard cards and the alert rule. Dario — can you draft the PR description? Include idempotency tests and a small integration test for deferred queue behavior.
Dario F: On it. PR summary: "hybrid assign flow + idempotency guard to reduce ownership flaps from enrichment/webhook races; feature-flagged canary."
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: assign_hybrid_flow (default=false). Monitors: marketing.assign_flap_count, marketing.assign_latency_p95.
Hannah S: 15m sync to go over ownership of PR/mocks? 09:45 PT works for me.
Rahul M: Thanks everyone — goal: stabilise owner churn with minimal user-facing impact. Will post post-mortem if the canary needs rollback.
